Reference

Car stats

Six attributes. Eighteen base points per car. Different ways to spend them.

TOP SPEED
How fast the car can go without boost.
ACCELERATION
How quickly the car reaches speed.
CONTROL
How precisely and quickly the car steers while gripping the road.
DRIFT
How well the car retains speed and settles while drifting. Drift is always slower than Gas.
BOOST POWER
How strongly boost accelerates the car and raises its speed limit.
BOOST TANK
How long a full boost charge lasts.
